profile.address: 3323, Janitell Road, Kelker, Colorado Springs, El Paso County, Colorado, 80906
profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 at Colorado Springs, sits at coordinates reverse-geocoded to 3323 Janitell Road in the Kelker area of Colorado Springs, El Paso County, Colorado, an address derived from OpenStreetMap coordinates rather than confirmed directly on any T5 facility page reached this session, since T5's own locations pages load their facility listings dynamically via client-side JavaScript and returned only generic archive section headers ("Available Data Center Campuses," "Pre-leased Sites Under Construction," "Completed Projects") to a direct fetch, both this session and an earlier one. T5 Data Centers is a data center developer and owner that has operated for nearly two decades per its own site, licensed as a general contractor in 48 states, with 22 data centers developed and more than 4 million square feet of data center space and 3-plus gigawatts of managed capacity across its national portfolio as of the operator's most recently reachable public figures; those figures describe the company as a whole rather than this specific building. Colorado Springs has drawn colocation and enterprise IT investment as a secondary Front Range market to the larger Denver metro cluster, benefiting from Colorado's lower disaster risk profile relative to coastal markets and proximity to several military and aerospace-adjacent institutions in the area, though this registry does not attribute that broader market context to specific building-level facts it cannot confirm. No facility-specific square footage, MW capacity, or year-opened figure for this Colorado Springs building was located in sourcing reachable this session. This registry treats the reverse-geocoded street address as a locational approximation rather than an operator-confirmed detail, and updates it if a future session locates a working, JavaScript-rendered version of T5's own facility page for this site.

profile.reading: T5 Charlotte Campus sits at 131 Riverside Court, Kings Mountain, North Carolina 28086, roughly 30 miles from Charlotte Douglas International Airport with direct freeway access, per the operator's own campus page. The campus is served by an on-site 180 MVA Duke Energy substation with dual 100 kV transmission lines and concrete-encased duct banks throughout the park, and T5 cites a power cost of $0.048 per kWh and 99.9999 percent utility power reliability as selling points for the site. The page describes a master-planned enterprise data center campus across three available sites: Site 1 at 23 acres, Site 2 at 17 acres (combinable with Site 1), and Site 3 at 14 acres, though it does not state which, if any, site corresponds to this specific mapped building, so no site-specific square footage or MW capacity is assigned here. The campus holds ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 certifications, and North Carolina offers a 100 percent sales tax abatement on qualifying data center equipment and software plus real and personal property tax rebates, incentives T5's own page cites directly for this site. T5 Data Centers itself has operated for nearly two decades per its own site, licensed as a general contractor in 48 states, with 22 data centers developed and more than 4 million square feet of data center space and 3-plus gigawatts of managed capacity across its national portfolio; those company-wide figures are separate from this specific site's own stated specifications above. No building-specific square footage, MW capacity, or year-opened figure was published for this exact site on the pages reachable this session. No further site-specific breakdown by acre parcel is available on the pages reachable this session, so this reading applies only the confirmed campus-wide figures above.

profile.address: Cuyahoga County, Ohio (specific municipality and street address not given in the operator's own fact sheet)
profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 at Cleveland, sits in Cuyahoga County, Ohio. The operator own PDF fact sheet describes a single building totaling 187,000 square feet, with 142,000 square feet immediately available and more than 50,000 square feet of data center space. It states 2.5 MW N+1 currently available, expandable to 6 plus MW N+1, with 9.75 MW of total generator capacity and 6.5 MW N+1 generator redundancy, dual 34.5 kV electrical feeders, 275,000 gallon thermal energy storage tanks, and 62,000 gallons of fuel storage. The document describes SSAE 16, SOC 1 and SOC 2, and FISMA Moderate alignment. No street address is given in this source. T5 Data Centers is a data center developer and owner that has operated for nearly two decades per its own site, licensed as a general contractor in 48 states, with 22 data centers developed and more than 4 million square feet of data center space and 3-plus gigawatts of managed capacity across its national portfolio; those company-wide figures are separate from this specific building's own stated specifications above. Cuyahoga County, encompassing Cleveland and its inner suburbs, has drawn data center and colocation investment in part on the strength of Ohio's state and local tax abatement programs for qualifying data center equipment purchases, a factor several operators in this registry's Ohio holdings cite directly on their own materials. This entry's Ohio location is confirmed by the operator's own PDF fact sheet, but that document gives no street address for the facility, and this row remains one of two nearly-identical "T5 at Cleveland" records roughly 100 meters apart in this registry that may represent the same physical building mapped twice rather than two distinct buildings; that open question is not resolved this session for lack of an address to confirm or rule out a match.

No street address is given in this source.

reading:
T5 Data Centers has operated since 2008, per its own site tagline, Creating Forever On Data Centers Since 2008. The company's own About page does not state a headquarters address or current ownership structure, and no other source reviewed this session confirmed one, so headquarters is left unrecorded here rather than inferred from facility branding.

T5's leadership team is described as having collectively designed, developed, or operated more than 100 mission critical facilities across their careers, a combined-experience figure rather than T5's own current portfolio size. The company's site references facilities in Chicago and Elk Grove, Illinois, Charlotte, North Carolina, and Portland, Oregon, alongside a numbered T5@Atlanta campus series in Georgia, where trade press separately reports T5 announcing a 300 megawatt data center campus.

T5 was named alongside Infomart Data Centers as one of two asset sources IPI Partners drew on when forming STACK Infrastructure in 2019, a fact recorded in this registry's STACK Infrastructure entry. However, T5's own site remains active and distinctly branded, with no reference to STACK, indicating T5 continued operating independently after that transaction rather than being fully absorbed. This row is treated as a separate, currently operating company rather than a duplicate of STACK Infrastructure. The registry here tracks 3 T5 facilities across two states, Illinois and Ohio.
